are now being made electronic.

2. All ROs/SROs are requested to workout the Cost Savings on similar pattern or

summery in tabular form, after checking the data and satisfying themselves that these are
correct.

3. This would enable us to compile the total savings made by our Organization in

Sub. : Introduction of NEFT — Cost saving — Carbon credit — Regarding.

Sir,

Hon’ble CPFC may kindly recall the discussion he had some time back about the saving
in paper as well as expenditure, consequent upon introduction of NEFT for disbursement of
payments to the provident fund members. As discussed, an attempt has been made to work out
the paper saving and attendant cost being incurred after the introduction of NEFT. Details are
annexed herewith. It will be seen that implementation of NEFT system for payment of PF
settlement has resulted in saving of €17,51,121/- during the period from May, 2010 to Jan.,2011.

I may submit that the other field offices may also be requested to evaluate the cost cutting
and saving on account of ‘paper being made by the organisation as a whole. I may also submit
that a comprehensive proposal can be formulated for forwarding to the Ministry of Environment
for claiming carbon credit on account of implementation of such eco friendly measures. Needless
to mention that introduction of NEFT payment has also resulted in expediting credit to the Bank
account of PF members and thus minimizing their grievances.

Yours faithfully,

eee

Regional P.F. Commissioner — I
Delhi (North)

Encl. : as above

Dated 23.02.2011
